amendment.amendment_reason: Retrieval feasibility and reproducibility. The pre-registered 30Min intraday liquidity ranking required roughly 1,675 Alpaca HTTP pages per month because Alpaca paginates 30Min multi-symbol responses at ~750-800 rows per page, making the full 12-month build 5-6 hours. Replacing the ranking input with Alpaca SIP 1Day bars reduces ranking pages by ~30x while preserving the median-dollar-volume ranking structure.
inspected_only: 1Day vs 5Min regular-session close/volume parity and sensitivity on a 60-symbol sample

reference_snapshot_policy.duplicate_symbol_policy: Exclude any ticker with more than one reference record in the same PIT snapshot
reference_snapshot_policy.active_inactive_overlap_policy: Active membership is taken from the active snapshot only. A ticker present in both active and inactive snapshots on the same PIT date is treated as active for universe eligibility and the inactive row is retained only for lifecycle provenance.
reference_snapshot_policy.if_pagination_or_pit_provenance_missing: Surface explicitly; do not turn into an empty successful snapshot

liquidity_ranking.rank_metric: median Alpaca SIP 1Day dollar volume over the previous 20 complete XNYS sessions
liquidity_ranking.dollar_volume_formula: session_dollar_volume = Alpaca SIP 1Day close * Alpaca SIP 1Day volume
liquidity_ranking.information_cutoff: before the first XNYS regular session of the effective month

ranking_timeframe_parity_probe.note: 30Min/5Min parity probe is superseded by the 1Day amendment. A bounded 60-symbol sensitivity check was performed instead.

sensitivity_evidence.sample_description: First 60 eligible common-stock symbols from the 2024-12-31 Massive active snapshot, using the first 20 complete XNYS sessions of January 2025.
sensitivity_evidence.1Day_vs_5Min_absolute_dollar_volume_diff: approximately 30-60% higher in 1Day because 1Day volume includes pre-market and after-hours activity
sensitivity_evidence.interpretation: The bounded sample top-50 set was identical, but absolute dollar-volume values differed. This sample is not proof that all monthly universes will be identical; it supports feasibility of the 1Day total-liquidity proxy for ranking.

liquidity_ranking.accepted_limitation: Alpaca SIP 1Day volume is a total-liquidity proxy that includes pre-market and after-hours trading activity not reproduced by summing regular-session intraday bars. It is not equivalent to regular-session-only volume.
liquidity_ranking.prior_close_source: Alpaca SIP 1Day close of the prior session
liquidity_ranking.shortfall_policy: If fewer than 50 stocks qualify, preserve the shortfall explicitly; do not relax thresholds or fill with lower-ranked symbols

ohlcv_policy.asof_policy: Use the effective PIT date (YYYY-MM-DD) as the asof parameter for every request. Record requested ticker, effective month, PIT date, requested asof, and returned symbol identity. Reject rows where returned symbol identity does not match requested ticker.

ranking_download_efficiency.1Day_ranking_justification: Alpaca SIP 1Day multi-symbol responses are paginated at ~10,000 rows per page, making the full ranking download 25-30x faster than 30Min while still supporting the top-50 median-dollar-volume ranking. 1Day volume is accepted as a total-liquidity proxy per the accepted_limitation.

stop_conditions: A PIT snapshot cannot paginate completely
Alpaca SIP is unavailable under the current entitlement
Returned feed or adjustment differs from the locked contract
Symbol identity cannot be joined deterministically
Estimated job is materially larger than the preregistered budget
The preregistration commit cannot be proven as an ancestor of the live-run head
out_of_scope: Use holdout data to alter universe, ranking, thresholds, or methodology
Import or invoke any strategy module
trading_impact: Research-only data and manifest infrastructure. No production signals, scores, weights, thresholds, rankings, eligibility, screeners, alerts, dashboards, brokerage, account, position, order, or trading behavior change.
